summary: XCHG Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing an ADS ratio change from one ADS representing 40 Class A ordinary shares to one ADS representing 800 Class A ordinary shares, equivalent to a 1-for-20 reverse ADS split. The change is effective August 21, 2026, with ADSs continuing to trade on Nasdaq under ticker XCH. The Bank of New York Mellon, as depositary, will automatically exchange every 20 existing ADSs for one new ADS; fractional entitlements will be aggregated and sold, with net proceeds distributed to holders. No ordinary shares are affected. This is a routine capital-structure administrative adjustment, not a special situation. What to watch: potential price volatility around the split effective date.
